name: Campus AI — TNEA Counselling Recommendation System
description: Existing CAMPUS AI upgrade focused on false-positive-free NLP, complete default filter states, eligible-only recommendations, college-code lookup, official TNEA knowledge and sidebar conversation controls.

stack.data: Supplied TNEA-Cleaned Dataset.csv (3,474 records / 438 colleges / 38 districts / 106 branches)

chatbot.fuzzy_matching: controlled; never fuzzy-matches arbitrary prose to branch catalogue
chatbot.natural_language_layer: optional Groq LLM with strict evidence grounding
chatbot.college_type: Government / Government-aided / University Department / Autonomous / Private filtering from dataset-supported classification
chatbot.abbreviation_support: TNEA branch codes and common English/Tamil/Tanglish abbreviations
chatbot.branch_aliases: AI/AI&DS/AIDS/AI & DS/Data Science/Artificial Intelligence and Data Science; AIML/AI&ML/AI & ML/Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning; plus common TNEA codes and full names

recommendation.na_handling: records without a published cutoff shown separately
recommendation.limit: 10000 records per response; dataset contains 3474 records
